symptom: ako/mxcli#1648: `create or modify` of a page whose combo box the statement changes (Label 'Booking' → 'Booking (changed)' in the describe output) deleted the combo box's custom content — txtOptionName, which MDL cannot author — while optionsSourceAssociationCustomContentType stayed 'yes': exec reported 'Replaced page', then mx check 11.13.0 CE0642 "Property 'Custom content' is required." at Widgets container 'Custom content' of combo box 'cbBooking'
cause: The #721 L4 pluggable passthrough keeps a stored pluggable widget's Type and Object only when the statement's widget equals what describe prints for it; a changed one is rebuilt from the template, which has no custom content. describe prints the content TYPE (so the rebuilt combo box keeps 'yes') but cannot print the content, so nothing carried it, and nothing refused
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_pluggable_passthrough.go (storedPluggable.hidden, storedHiddenContent, refuseLostHiddenContent, refuseChangedWithHiddenContent, hiddenContentRebuildError), cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (buildPluggable: refuse when the passthrough declines), cmd_pages_rewrite_guard.go (checkNoHiddenContentRebuilt in validateUnauthorableRewrites), cmd_pages_describe_omitted.go (note wording)
fix: A stored combo box whose custom content holds widgets is, when the passthrough declines it and the rebuild is a combo box again, refused by exec naming the widgets, with `alter page … set` (keeps the content) or drop-then-rewrite-without-the-type as the remedy; check -p refuses the same rewrite up front from describe's pairing, as #1622 does for widgets MDL cannot author. An unchanged combo box, another widget kind under the name, and a combo box without content are untouched
test: TestStoredHiddenContentReadsTheComboBoxContent, TestChangedComboBoxWithHiddenContentIsRefused, TestComboBoxWithHiddenContentControls (unchanged, no content, another widget kind, nested); mdl-examples/bug-tests/1648-rewrite-changed-combobox-keeps-custom-content.mdl
insight: **Refuse at the decision, not at a guess of it**: the passthrough already decides 'kept as stored' vs 'rebuilt'; hanging the refusal on its 'no' covers a context change under identical text too, which check — comparing only the text — cannot see, so exec's half is a superset of check's and they never contradict on the reported shape. A blanket #1622-style guard ('the page holds content MDL cannot author') would have refused every unchanged describe → exec, breaking GetPut, because unlike a classic data grid the combo box survives an unchanged rewrite. Scope it to the widget whose slots describe never prints (the combo box): for every other pluggable widget a child missing from the statement is a deletion the author wrote. Carrying the content instead would need the #1247 merge's TypePointer remap inside a template rebuild — the refusal is the honest smaller fix, and its remedy was measured to build clean
